note: Both sets contain vague or invented entities ("base block", "base component", bare "dimension" claims), but Set A repeats more of these and misbinds thickness-type attributes (e.g. "web thickness 1 1/2"", "flange thickness 5/8"", "thickness 5/8"") that the drawing does not support. Set B captures two important facts Set A omits entirely — the L3X3X1/4 support angle designation and the 1 1/2" = 1'-0" drawing scale — plus the 3/8" through-bolt diameter and correctly scoped segment lengths (3'-8 3/8", 2'-11 7/8"). Set B's main errors are the misbound 2'-3 7/8" attributed to Module B (it belongs to Module A) and the 5/8" "base offset" on the C1/S-301 reference, along with several invented base-block claims. Overall Set B has fewer unsupported bindings and more faithful, correctly scoped claims.
